tools.name: whoami
tools.title: Who am I
tools.description: Return the signed-in user's identity and clinic roles. Use it to verify the connection works and what access is available.

tools.name: list_clinics
tools.title: List clinics
tools.description: List the active clinics the signed-in user can access, including name, city, phone and doctor details.

tools.name: list_appointments
tools.title: List appointments
tools.description: List clinic appointments in a date range. Returns scheduling data only (time, duration, status, clinic) and never patient identifiers or medical details.

from.description: Start of the range, ISO date or datetime. Defaults to now.

to.description: End of the range, ISO date or datetime. Defaults to 14 days after `from`.

clinic_id.description: Optional clinic id to filter by. Pass an empty string for all clinics.

limit.description: Maximum rows to return. Capped at 200.

tools.name: get_schedule_summary
tools.title: Get schedule summary
tools.description: Aggregate appointment counts per day and per status for a date range. Contains no patient data.

from.description: Start of the range, ISO date or datetime. Defaults to today.

days.description: Number of days to summarize, capped at 60. Defaults to 7.
